source: input: `say -v Samantha -o en.wav --data-format=LEI16@16000 "I just got the internship!"` then `afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@16000 -c 1` (01 §7 FX-006, A15). text_reference = the text given to say (demo-plan.json captures[happy-en]).
compare_note: Send input.wav as the body with Content-Type audio/wav (03 §9); response 200 {text}. WER of text vs text_reference after lowercasing and removing punctuation (en tokens = words; zh tokens = characters, whitespace ignored) must be within 0.15 of 0 (REQ-001). language: computed from text with the rule 'en = Latin letters, no Han; zh = Han characters, no Latin word; no other script (Cyrillic, kana, Hangul…)' and compared exactly (REQ-002).
pass: REQ-001: error rate <= 0.15 (after warm-up); REQ-002: language matches in 3/3 runs (FX-006 + FX-007 = 6/6)
